reels.title: Qualcomm and Arm Holdings share slide as the two see weakness in smartphone market
reels.summary:
Qualcomm stock slid on Thursday, leading chip stocks lower after the company issued a light forecast.

Semiconductor peers, including Arm Holdings, also declined Thursday, continuing a post-election selloff on fears of a data center slowdown, as Democrats indicated plans for artificial intelligence regulation.

reels.title: Nasdaq plummets into correction territory, Dow drops more than 1,000 points
reels.summary:
The Nasdaq Composite plummeted on Thursday, erasing the sharp gains from the previous session, as investors continued to rotate away from technology stocks and into more defensive areas of the market.

CNBC's Mike Santoli reports.

reels.title: Uber reported third quarter earnings results. 💰
reels.summary:
Uber reported third quarter results on Wednesday, topping Wall Street's estimates, but rising costs and weakness in the Middle East market are expected to hit Q4 performance. 🚕

Uber forecasted for Q4 an adjusted EPS of $0.95 to $0.99, which is below estimates of $1.06.

reels.title: Richmond Fed president sees interest rate hikes ahead, but at a gradual pace
reels.summary: Richmond Federal Reserve President Thomas Barkin said Thursday that he expects the central bank will have to raise interest rates further, though he’s not sure by how much or at what pace.

reels.title: AMD's CEO doesn't see superintelligence demand slowing down anytime soon.

Despite the market’s shortsighted outlook, in the long term, AMD’s CEO sees AI becoming more essential to our daily lives and to its business.
